retirement.reason: provident and pension fund money is locked until you’re eligible to withdraw

checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?

checklist.name: Provident fund
checklist.ask: Do you have a provident fund, or GPF, through work?
checklist.hint: Your fund’s latest statement shows the balance.

checklist.name: Tax-saving funds
checklist.ask: Any RMF, SSF or ThaiESG units still in their holding period?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?
checklist.hint: Units past their holding period count with your other investments.

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any other investments — shares, mutual funds, an investing app?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Home loan
checklist.ask: Is there a home loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest loan statement shows what’s outstanding.

checklist.name: Vehicle
checklist.ask: Do you own a car or a motorbike?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Hire purchase
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?

checklist.name: Other loans
checklist.ask: Anything else you owe — a student loan, a personal loan or a card balance?
